Pick the fall from which you would not come back, and that is your barrier. It is a decision rather than a discovery, and everything below uses half the account, for a reason one division makes plain: a 50% fall needs a 100% gain to undo, which is the point at which recovery stops being ordinary arithmetic and starts being a second career. Set yours at a shallower fall and the numbers below get larger; set it deeper and they get smaller. What does not change is that the probability of touching it is computable once the level is named.
